title: 5.3.7 Lab: Score one point per touch
description: The starter scores on every frame the ball touches the goal, so the number races. Fix it with a remembered last frame, so one landing is worth one point.

steps.title: Ask once per frame, not per test
steps.instructions: Run the starter and push the ball into the gold block: the score races. In `draw()`, check the touch **once**, into a variable, so the rest of the frame can look at the same answer.
hints: `const touching = ball.colliding(goal);` — after this line, `touching` holds this frame's answer.
Reread 5.3.5 (Reading: A collision is not an event) if the difference between this frame and last frame is not clear yet.

steps.title: Compare with the frame before
steps.instructions: Add a variable outside `draw()` that remembers whether the ball was touching last frame. Add a point only when the ball is touching now **and** was not a frame ago. Then store this frame's answer in the variable, every frame.
hints: The line `wasTouching = touching;` must run outside the `if`, or the count never resets and the second landing scores nothing.

steps.title: Prove it
steps.instructions: Press R three times and let the ball land each time. The score should read exactly 3, no matter how long the ball rests on the block.
hints: If it reads 1 and stops, the remembered variable is never updated.

requirements.title: The touch is checked once into a variable
requirements.description: This frame's collision answer is stored in a variable, so the same answer is used for the test and the memory. Help: 5.3.5 (Reading: A collision is not an event)

requirements.title: A point is added only when contact starts
requirements.description: The score goes up when the ball is touching now and was not touching a frame ago. Help: 5.3.5 (Reading: A collision is not an event)

requirements.title: The memory is updated every frame
requirements.description: Last frame's answer is replaced with this frame's answer on every frame, so the next touch is recognised. Help: 5.3.5 (Reading: A collision is not an event)
